files.envfile.py:
def parse_env(text):
    """Reads KEY=value lines into a dict.

    Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are skipped. One pair of matching
    single or double quotes around a value is removed. Everything after the
    first '=' belongs to the value.
    """
    settings = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        value = value.strip()
        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "'\"":
            value = value[1:-1]
        settings[key.strip()] = value
    return settings
